series_label: Maternal mortality ratio (modeled estimate, per 100,000 live births)
unit: Per 100,000 live births (data series unit code DT_10P5BR_L, 'Deaths per 100 000 live births')
source_or_custodian: WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, World Bank Group, and UNDESA/Population Division (Maternal Mortality Estimation Inter-Agency Group, MMEIG); distributed in World Development Indicators (WB_WDI)
release_or_vintage: Metadata version_date 2026-07-01; metadata release date and last-update date not provided (null); time coverage in metadata 1985-2023
status_or_notes: Values returned for 2000-2023 only. No values were returned for 2024 or 2025 (series latest year is 2023). Metadata warns the methodology differs from earlier estimates, so values should not be compared historically with previous releases. Server also lists a separate national-estimate series, WB_WDI_SH_STA_MMRT_NE (Maternal mortality ratio (national estimate, per 100,000 live births)), which was not queried. A validation note said the member_economies_only filter was not applied; this does not affect the pinned NGA query.
definition: Number of women who die from pregnancy-related causes while pregnant or within 42 days of pregnancy termination per 100,000 live births. Estimated with a regression model using the proportion of maternal deaths among non-AIDS deaths in women aged 15-49, fertility, birth attendants, and GDP (PPP). Metadata notes the statistical reliability is generally unknown and the ratios cannot be assumed to be exact.
